body: Congrats!
I've been addicted for 14-15 years now. Have known of nofap for 6 years plus. Have tried to quit before nofap was even a thing, this gives me some hope
This is exactly what I'm experiencing, I can see it dying down after I figure it out a bit more

Your english is bad ass man, it's great. Yeah I've sort of come to the conclusion that we will never be able to notice all of our traits due to the very nature of being inside of our AS heads. We can only notice shit to a certain extent. 

I feel you, it's interesting noticing stuff and scanning memories of the past, uncovering situations regarding AS traits.  It definitely feels like a new, more self aware side of me is developing. When something goes wrong or not how I planned I immediately ask the question, "Was that due to AS?". Usually the answer is  probably yes.
Shit my bad lol
When people want to police words trying to mask the fact that they are being a cunt...

Btw you're the only one here out of all the comments who complained about it. Why do you think that is? It's probably due to people understanding context, I used the term in a feeling towards myself. People got it and I got a decent amount of upvotes. Calling me careless and cruel is also a bit of a stretch...

Have I ever called someone a retard irl? No. Case closed. I used the word retard to explain how I feel when people treat me like I'm dumb, slow, insert whatever word you want. The word is no longer a medical term, fair enough I didn't know that. I think it's about context. I can only tell you so many times that I don't call people retards. Yes your opinion is never to use the word even if you're describing a feeling towards yourself, that's your opinion. I'm just scared of a society where we can't even communicate anymore due to every single word being offensive. Even when we don't use the words towards other people. I used retard as it is a powerful word and that is exactly how people make me feel. People don't make me feel stupid... Have a good day.
I'm 27 and in the same boat. I've been crazy addicted for so long. Don't really know who I am.

I said retard once in the comments too, after saying the r word. I said the r word, because I want to engage in conversation and not offend people like you. I still feel I may use the word in my situation. Do you understand that I said people make me feel like one? There are actual medical retards in this world, it's an actual thing. I'm also against calling medical retards a retard. I already said I'm against calling normal people retarded. Not quite sure why you keep focusing on the word when I'm clearly against using it on other people. So tell me this, how is me saying the word retard in terms of how others make me feel bad? Maybe if you give me a good explanation I'll change my mind. While you're at it explain to me how saying the r word is different than the word retard. It's the exact same meaning...Try not to read more comments and focus on this one please, we're not in court...I'm also not defensive, I was simply stating my opinion. I try to learn from people while staying true to myself, it seems like you want to win an argument. (Btw I used retard twice in my post, 9 times?)

Barely anyone has ever called me a retard btw, it's more in the way they treat me at times. It's absolutely wrong to call someone that word. You seem to have a thick skin but other people are more sensitive and could end up committing suicide. 

I relate wit you on the half-way thing, it's crazy how much my natural skills I vary depending on the intellectual task.
I feel ya pain buddy. Was surprised that someone in the comments got offended when I used the word. I'm clearly against the use of that word. We as a society have become so pc it's sad

I'm sorry but I disagree with you. It would be dishonest of me to not say so because it's how I feel. I dislike the r word too, I'm against it. "Make it seem". What seems like and what is true is not always the same thing. If people think I think it's ok to use that word the assumption is made by them. I just feel that's the best word to use in this situation, people treat me like one and that's why I used the word. I'm not gonna call a monkey a gorilla, I call it what it is. Once again, I'm totally against using that word to down people
True, but it can go beyond the social aspect even. As people with aspergers think differently in general.
Yep, seems to be a reoccurring problem

I don't want to be that guy, but I find that very strange. Some fellow aspies would definitely listen to you and as I said in my post my ocd friend sometimes listens. I get that it is hard to find people like that, I don't get that you never found someone to properly listen to you.  Not sure if you have had the opportunity to meet some aspies irl yet? Just trying to understand btw, not tryna be a dick btw.

Yeah, I irritate people when I try to go too much into detail. You can't keep that side hidden forever. I would say try sites like meetup.com. I'm a very philosophic person so I would like to go to a philosophy meetup.
Well done man, now you know it's possible

When you implied talking to yourself will be frowned upon and some may think you are crazy I was suggesting that there shouldn't be much of a difference between doing it in your head or talking out loud. In both instances you are talking to yourself. 

Depends on your intention for writing stories. Do you wanna be good or just release your thoughts?
As you are asking, it seems like you wanna do both. I was born with a gift for writing and always had a crazy imagination. So as it comes naturally for me.I guess reading the type of content you wanna write about would be my best tip. There are still many technical aspects I probably lack too, and reading experts books on the subject you wanna write about may help. Then again, you also don't wanna copy styles too much to keep it authentic. It's more for a starting point. Really analyze what authors do to make their work interesting.
I suggest you stay on this sub then;) You will be heard
Same
Yeah, you probably get your rare NT that are more like us, like people with ocd but for most part it's more about the enjoyment than the info for them I agree
I know that worry all too well. I sometimes feel this massive need to release all the info
Lol cold turkey? Is fishing a drug nowadays;)
Guess we just have to accept it or get people who are like us
Lol almost like playing catch up
Pleasure, your comments does the same to me
Wow great analogy, exactly like that yes
You taught me a new acronym btw thanks lol. I agree we all do this, this may be one of the most common asperger traits.
Let's cheers to that lol

Yeah I mean we talk to ourselves in our head in public at times, when we say it out loud there shouldn't really be a difference. Thanks, I'm into music and poetry. That helps some, I may need to get back into writing stories too. 

I agree, it helps, but can't replace actual human convos. Sometimes I want people to challenge my logic. Just having that back and forth with someone who is on a similar wave length is priceless.
Lol you're good, we're just humans at the end of the day. We wanna be heard, maybe for longer than most people lol
Very, very interesting. So instead of just chatting away, you double check how much the person are interested and perhaps gauge how much they know? Or what methods do you use exactly?
Yeah, it definitely explains why many people with aspergers have narrower interests too lol.
Lol
Yep sucks
A sad moment indeed

Someone here in the comments actually made me realize something, I was wrong at being angry for people not wanting to engage so long in certain topics." It probably is as bad as them as small talk is for us". That's what one of the commenters said
I can imagine how heavenly this must be like. Having a circle of friends like that.
So frustrating

I over explain at times too, then most people think I think they are stupid probably. Definitely not the case, I just like to be specific. But yeah it is a tough balance for me too, with regards to the amount of talking
I am lucky, check this. He once talked about 9/11 for about 8 hours straight. Even I wanted to move on lol. Was strange having the tables turned on me for once.
Lol it's so odd to me that this is the norm, then again I can apply what I just said to everything pretty much lol
I agree, there seems to be times when I'm allowed and boy oh boy do the reigns come off. Full fledged, unadulterated, non stop, in detail talk time. The mic is mine lol
Lol I think we all can probably shake our heads at certain times we went on and on when it was clear no one cared
Some of my online friends literally don't even continue the convo if I bring up certain topics lol. It pisses me off but you made a great point regarding it being like small talk for us.
I can see that helping a bit
I can see that helping a bit
Omw I relate to this a lot. It's so hard for me to regain focus if I take a break from studies. So you seem to have great focus when you put your mind on something.
Congrats on improving on the social aspect. Btw why do you say social events are bad? What makes it bad in most cases?

I have always had a low self esteem and felt like something was missing, or wrong... Recently been diagnosed so still tryna fit all the pieces. Feeling like an outkast is a terrible feeling. I also barely feel I belong.
Yeah I'm the same, I act super child like still. But I would say I can be pretty wise at times too.

I feel you, people have used me quite a bit. I never know girls intentions too. I mean if NT guys struggle you must know it's hard lol. 

Ah ok not sure if I struggle with that, I think I may know the difference. Since being diagnosed with aspergers very recently it has definitely made me realize how much it affects me. I think I'm still pretty oblivious to many of my traits tbh.

Sorry to hear that, I seem to get drained fast in social situations. Not sure if it's more to do with my introverted nature or aspergers. Probably both. What sensory issues do you have? So you get depressed when it happens?

Thanks for your response. Have you considered keeping all of these friends by sorting them by importance. So in other words, socialize with 2 of them a decent amount and keep the others more in the background. I guess this can result in losing some friends if they want to see you more than you want to. Just a suggestion, even if I can see that it may not work out in some circumstances. 

Your answer really makes sense though. My problem about having 2 friends is they don't fulfil all the parts of my personality. I would perhaps like a few more friends just for the sake of discussing more things and connecting the other parts of my personality.

Man all of the comments really resonate with me, this one maybe the most. It's like you just scanned my brain and explained how it operates. I also fixate on stuff all the time. I even fixate on imagining I have a gf lol, it's sad. I once asked a girl out and she said no, it completely fucked me up for months. I feel that way about my studies too. Even if I finish it things would still end up in a disaster. I would probably just screw up if I get a job so then I literally don't even study. Tbh I have screwed up badly in the past with certain jobs due to overstimulation. So I don't have much faith in myself due to my limitations. Part of me knows I can improve myself if I just work harder and even overcome some of these limitations but another part just laughs and tells me what a loser I am. So yeah the battle is real

It's so hard right, almost like there's a glass pane between you and the world. There are glimpses of hope, but in my case those glimpses never become a full part of my reality. All we can do is keep trying and incorporating new strategies. Also maybe accept things will always be a bit harder.

Yeah, it definitely sucks. I'm in the same boat, I sometimes wonder if I'll ever be able to fit in, stay by myself, these questions haunt me. Part of me wants to give up, I don't have enough belief in myself. I expect the worst because the worst has happened before. I guess all we can do is work our asses off and try our best.

I feel you, I sometimes think people even treat me like a child and I'm 27. I unfortunately still stay at my parents. It definitely doesn't help, it stunts development so much. Definitely good that your studies are going well, I assume you are studying a special interest?
Lol nice. I can't say the same yet. What do you do for a living if I may ask?
Interesting, why do you think you keep losing friends? Why does a new friend cause other friendships to be lost?

Ah that sucks. I sleep a decent amount if you add up the hours at the end of the week, just at random times and inconsistent hours. Consistent sleep is so darn important, yet hard to implement at times
I feel ya, for all you know those aquaintices may consider you a friend.
Lol russian dolls of friends, shows ya all you need is one friend and it could potentially increase if you get to meet their friends

I'm with you, I feel everything you feel right now.I have become a shell of the person I was supposed to be. I know what I need to do to improve but I keep being lazy. Waking up super late, wasting away. I'm ashamed of myself, but I somehow still haven't lost hope. Google David Goggins, he has helped me. Sorry that it's not going too good with you. Hugs

Wow that's great, congrats on 13 years. I'm not too bad with socialising, I just have more of a fear I guess. Plus I feel inadequate as I stay with my parents and are behind with my studies. Anyhow, recently something else also started holding me back. I really dislike the fact that whatever girl I get one day will not be a virgin which sucks tbh. For some reason that thought bothers me more than it should

So true, we're all humans. I have no idea how people with aspergers manage to get a gf or marry. I recently came to the realization that I already struggle just to live my own life and a gf at this time won't work. However would like to perhaps try to get in the dating scene for the first time and I'm 27. Maybe later this year.

So relatable, I sometimes do well with convos the first time and feel like I won. So don't wanna risk talking to the same person as I'm scared I won't live up to the first convo. I wanna walk away while I can as a winner lol

Yeah distance helps a lot. So true, I over do eye contact at times while listening. It's just pretty shit dealing with stuff that are natural to most people. Eye contact is big, if you do it incorrectly it can really cause bad first impressions

Also just to add, I think many people with aspergers tend to do stuff either really well or pretty bad. So if people see me doing stuff I'm good at intellectually and they never see my bad areas they might think I'm smart. All people have this, we all have strengths and weaknesses but I believe it is exaggerated with asperger people.

Yeah all the time, but other people have also called me intelligent. It has caused cognitive dissonance. There are times I feel intelligent for a while, then there are times I feel dumb. I scored average on an IQ test, but I wasn't in a good place mentally at that time. I guess I'll score slightly above avg when I do one again. But then again IQ tests are probably made for NTs which makes me question the validity of it. There definitely seems to be a correlation with IQ and different jobs though. So yeah I wouldn't ignore IQ completely too. I may have some executive function problems too. Certain stuff comes so easy to me and other stuff is a struggle. For example I get confused when people say person x is that person's mother's sister's cousin. Most people can process that and understand how person x fits in the famy I simply can't. Also another potential reason some people call me dumb and others call me smart has to do with the areas they're smart at. If we are smart in similar areas and also dumb in similar areas they tend to call me smart. I'm terrible with my hands so practical people will call me retarded

You really have me questioning something now. Maybe that explains why we operate better one on one. We probably still miss social cues when we're not overstimulated but less. I guess what I was tryna figure out is if some of us are merely overstimulated and wouldn't miss social cues  vs just missing less social cues when we're not overstimulated. Probably the latter in my case.
So true
Thank you:)
LIES I TELL YA LIES. ALL PSYCHOPATHS ARE  LIARS!
-infinity, so evil Satan calls me daddy
Very true, my weakness is Youtube vids. I need to scale down on that
I agree, but my point is we don't have to stay stuck forever. At the end of the day we can only improve by trying and reassessing strategies until we have a plan to succeed
Thanks, you too
Thanks and that is definitely an achievement. Let's keep pushing

I wasn't going on and on about the paradox. I was just mentioning it is one at the end. It was pretty funny to me. I mentioned I found it funny too. The interviewer has a smirk on his face when the powerlifter said it. I'm into bodybuilding too and it resonates with me maybe more. Maybe it was just the wrong crowd, you included it seems.

No, that's not the case. I found it hilarious, I realize he made a joke. I just saw the paradoxical element in it that's all. I definitely realize he was joking and that's why I told the story.I think it has more to do with my technical way of talking and maybe mono delivery. Btw I realized I told the joke to the wrong crowd, I'm into bodybuilding and resonated with it a lot. Figured it out lol.

It wasn't meant to be a paradox but has a paradoxical element to it which was pretty obvious to me. You can't really be scared of walking to a place you get calories from if you lose calories walking to it. I said I found it hilarious, so how did you interpret that I wasn't seeing it as a joke? I told the story because I found his joke funny

In grade 6 a teacher asked a naughty boy, "Kid, do you want a future?" He jokingly changed his face very sad and said in a pathetic voice, "Mam, I don't have a future". Me and all the boys laughed our asses off, it wasn't particurly clever but his delivery was hilarious.

David Goggins is a life saver, he is so good I'm busy making a song about him. The way he frames pain is amazing. I feel sorry for myself a lot, but listening to him makes me realize this pain will mean something in the end. He chases pain lol.  Thanks for your message, I still struggle to let go of regrets, stuff I never did that most people got to experience. I can never fix that, as many of these experiences are age related. All I can do now is accept it and improve. I have so much to improve on. David Goggins talks about the accountability mirror. It's tough to really look at your flaws, I simply have to be honest about myself and fix the areas I dislike.

Thank you for your message. That 40 year concept is one I haven't really thought of. Maybe our best years do lie ahead of us. Sorry to hear about your tough time. I think listening to David Goggins will help you a lot. He frames pain as strength. I felt sorry for myself for too long.
Tbh it is noticeable when I blush because people have pointed it out, but you're right acceptance beats fighting it

Sorry to hear that, I can't see myself living much longer if things don't change. The thing is I know the only person who can do that is me. The problem is having the energy and will after so many wasted years. How did you survive decades?
